# Invitation Draft: Independent Operations Specialist

**Recipient:** [Nominate only after written authority verification]

Subject: PARMAR independent Operations review request

Please review the supported SQLite topology, backup/restore, migration and
rollback evidence, reconciliation/fencing, Environment isolation, monitoring
and recovery design.

Required expertise: production operations, SQLite or bounded distributed
systems, migration cutover and disaster recovery. Independence: no unilateral
implementation authority or responsibility for approving your own operations
changes.

Artifacts: `.github/approval/review-packages/operations.md` and the exact
worktree SHA-256 values under `roles.Operations` in
`.github/approval/specialist-handoff-artifacts.json`. These are candidate
digests only; verify and rebind them to the exact reviewed commit before
submitting an approval record.

Respond with `APPROVED`, `REJECTED` or `NEEDS_CHANGES`, rationale, evidence,
limitations, conditions and an attributable GitHub review.
